rationale.hitl-workflow: PRV makes human verification a defined pre-merge checkpoint with blocking authority.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Verify prescribes linting and lightweight automated tests before trust.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Prompt logs and tagged commits persist AI-change history for accountability.
rationale.quality-debt: PRV targets maintainability debt through mandatory human-guided refactoring.
rationale.framework: PRV provides a reusable three-stage development-workflow design.
rationale.design-only: Authors specify stages and conventions but report no implementation or evaluation.
rationale.assistive: Humans initiate conversational generation and remain authors throughout iterative acceptance.
rationale.steering: Prompt and Refactor substantively shape generation inputs and revisions.
rationale.risk-quality: Refactoring mitigates readability, maintainability, duplication, and architectural inconsistency.
rationale.risk-overreliance: The framework targets uncritical acceptance by requiring verification before trust.
